WITH scoped AS (
    -- All txs in the selected run(s): used to compute p95
    SELECT
        txstats.clarity_runtime
    FROM stacks_tx_stats AS txstats
    JOIN stacks_tx       AS tx ON tx.id = txstats.stacks_tx_id
    JOIN benchmark_run   AS br ON br.id = txstats.benchmark_run_id
    [[WHERE {{run_id}}]]          -- optional run filter (Metabase field filter)
),

p95 AS (
    -- True 95th percentile: pick the element at floor(0.95 * (N-1))
    SELECT
        clarity_runtime AS p95_runtime
    FROM scoped
    ORDER BY clarity_runtime
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET (
        SELECT CAST(0.95 * (COUNT(*) - 1) AS INTEGER) FROM scoped
    )
),

this_tx AS (
    -- Runtime for the selected tx (avg in case multiple runs are selected)
    SELECT
        AVG(txstats.clarity_runtime) AS tx_runtime
    FROM stacks_tx_stats AS txstats
    JOIN stacks_tx       AS tx ON tx.id = txstats.stacks_tx_id
    JOIN benchmark_run   AS br ON br.id = txstats.benchmark_run_id
    WHERE {{txid}}                 -- txid hex field filter
      [[AND {{run_id}}]]           -- optional run filter again
)

SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * this_tx.tx_runtime / p95.p95_runtime, 1) AS pct_of_p95
FROM this_tx, p95;

WITH span_per_run AS (
    SELECT
        br.id    AS benchmark_run_id,
        ps.name  AS span_name,

        -- per-run exclusive wall + cpu in ms
        SUM(pr.self_wall_time_us) / 1000.0 AS self_wall_ms,
        SUM(pr.self_cpu_time_us)  / 1000.0 AS self_cpu_ms
    FROM profiler_record AS pr
    JOIN stacks_tx      AS tx ON tx.id = pr.stacks_tx_id
    JOIN profiler_span  AS ps ON ps.id = pr.profiler_span_id
    JOIN benchmark_run  AS br ON br.id = pr.benchmark_run_id
    WHERE {{txid}}
      [[AND {{run_id}}]]      -- Metabase field filter on benchmark_run.id
    GROUP BY
        br.id,
        ps.name
)

SELECT
    span_name,

    -- average exclusive CPU time per run (ms)
    AVG(self_cpu_ms) AS avg_self_cpu_ms,

    -- average "wait" time per run (ms) = wall - CPU, clamped at 0
    AVG(
        CASE
            WHEN self_wall_ms > self_cpu_ms
            THEN self_wall_ms - self_cpu_ms
            ELSE 0.0
        END
    ) AS avg_self_wait_ms,

    -- total exclusive wall time just for ordering / optional display
    AVG(self_wall_ms) AS avg_self_wall_ms,

    COUNT(*) AS run_samples   -- how many runs contributed
FROM span_per_run
GROUP BY
    span_name
ORDER BY
    avg_self_wall_ms DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH RECURSIVE prof_base AS (
    SELECT
        pr.*,
        ps.name AS span_name,
        pl.file,
        pl.line
    FROM profiler_record       AS pr
    JOIN profiler_span         AS ps ON ps.id = pr.profiler_span_id
    LEFT JOIN profiler_location AS pl ON pl.id = pr.profiler_location_id
),

roots AS (
    -- rows for this tx whose parent is NOT another row for the same tx
    SELECT pb.*
    FROM prof_base pb
    JOIN stacks_tx tx ON tx.id = pb.stacks_tx_id
    WHERE {{txid}}
      [[AND {{run_id}}]]
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM prof_base p2
          WHERE p2.id = pb.parent_id
            AND p2.stacks_tx_id = pb.stacks_tx_id
      )
),

tree AS (
    -- anchor: tx-local root(s)
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.parent_id,
        r.benchmark_run_id,
        r.depth,
        r.child_index,
        r.self_wall_time_us,
        r.self_cpu_time_us,
        r.span_name,
        r.file,
        r.line,
        printf('%04d', r.child_index) AS sort_path
    FROM roots r

    UNION ALL

    -- recursive: children of anything already in the tree
    SELECT
        child.id,
        child.parent_id,
        child.benchmark_run_id,
        child.depth,
        child.child_index,
        child.self_wall_time_us,
        child.self_cpu_time_us,
        child.span_name,
        child.file,
        child.line,
        parent.sort_path || '.' || printf('%04d', child.child_index) AS sort_path
    FROM prof_base child
    JOIN tree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id
)

SELECT
    id,
    parent_id,
    depth,
    child_index,

    -- nice hierarchical label
    substr('                    ', 1, depth * 2) || span_name AS span,

    -- timings in ms
    self_cpu_time_us / 1000.0 AS self_cpu_ms,
    CASE
        WHEN self_wall_time_us > self_cpu_time_us
        THEN (self_wall_time_us - self_cpu_time_us) / 1000.0
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS self_wait_ms,
    self_wall_time_us / 1000.0 AS self_wall_ms,

    file,
    line
FROM tree
ORDER BY sort_path;

WITH RECURSIVE prof_base AS (
    SELECT
        pr.*,
        ps.name AS span_name,
        pl.file,
        pl.line,
        sb.block_hash_hex,
        tx.tx_hash_hex
    FROM profiler_record        AS pr
    JOIN profiler_span          AS ps ON ps.id = pr.profiler_span_id
    LEFT JOIN profiler_location AS pl ON pl.id = pr.profiler_location_id
    LEFT JOIN stacks_block      AS sb ON sb.id = pr.stacks_block_id
    LEFT JOIN stacks_tx         AS tx ON tx.id = pr.stacks_tx_id
    WHERE 1 = 0 [[OR {{block_hash}}]]
      [[AND {{run_id}}]]
),

roots AS (
    SELECT pb.*
    FROM prof_base pb
    WHERE pb.stacks_block_id IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM prof_base p2
          WHERE p2.id = pb.parent_id
            AND p2.benchmark_run_id = pb.benchmark_run_id
            AND p2.stacks_block_id   = pb.stacks_block_id
      )
),

tree AS (
    -- full tree, no noise filtering here
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.parent_id,
        r.benchmark_run_id,
        r.depth,
        r.child_index,
        r.self_wall_time_us,
        r.self_cpu_time_us,
        r.wall_time_us,
        r.cpu_time_us,
        r.span_name,
        r.file,
        r.line,
        r.block_hash_hex,
        r.tx_hash_hex,
        printf('%04d', r.child_index) AS sort_path
    FROM roots r

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        child.id,
        child.parent_id,
        child.benchmark_run_id,
        child.depth,
        child.child_index,
        child.self_wall_time_us,
        child.self_cpu_time_us,
        child.wall_time_us,
        child.cpu_time_us,
        child.span_name,
        child.file,
        child.line,
        child.block_hash_hex,
        child.tx_hash_hex,
        parent.sort_path || '.' || printf('%04d', child.child_index) AS sort_path
    FROM prof_base child
    JOIN tree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id
),

totals AS (
    -- total wall time over the full tree (unfiltered)
    SELECT SUM(wall_time_us) AS total_wall_us
    FROM tree
),

filtered AS (
    -- now apply the noise toggle
    SELECT
        t.*,
        totals.total_wall_us
    FROM tree t
    CROSS JOIN totals
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND (
            {{hide_noise}} = 0
            OR t.self_wall_time_us / 1000.0 >= 0.3
          )
)

SELECT
    id,
    parent_id,
    depth,
    child_index,

    substr('                    ', 1, depth * 2) || span_name AS span,

    wall_time_us      / 1000.0 AS total_wall_ms,
    cpu_time_us       / 1000.0 AS total_cpu_ms,
    self_cpu_time_us  / 1000.0 AS self_cpu_ms,
    CASE
        WHEN self_wall_time_us > self_cpu_time_us
        THEN (self_wall_time_us - self_cpu_time_us) / 1000.0
        ELSE 0.0
    END                          AS self_wait_ms,
    self_wall_time_us / 1000.0   AS self_wall_ms,

    -- % of TOTAL block time, even when noise is filtered out
    ROUND(
        100.0 * wall_time_us / NULLIF(total_wall_us, 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_of_total_wall,

    tx_hash_hex,
    block_hash_hex,
    file,
    line
FROM filtered
ORDER BY
    tx_hash_hex,
    sort_path;

WITH span_per_run AS (
    SELECT
        br.id   AS benchmark_run_id,
        ps.name AS span_name,

        -- per-run exclusive wall + CPU in ms
        SUM(pr.self_wall_time_us) / 1000.0 AS self_wall_ms,
        SUM(pr.self_cpu_time_us)  / 1000.0 AS self_cpu_ms
    FROM profiler_record AS pr
    JOIN stacks_block    AS sb ON sb.id = pr.stacks_block_id
    JOIN profiler_span   AS ps ON ps.id = pr.profiler_span_id
    JOIN benchmark_run   AS br ON br.id = pr.benchmark_run_id
    WHERE 1 = 0                 -- force “no results” unless a block is picked
      [[OR {{block_hash}}]]     -- Field Filter mapped to stacks_block.block_hash_hex
      [[AND {{run_id}}]]        -- optional Field Filter mapped to benchmark_run.id
    GROUP BY
        br.id,
        ps.name
)

SELECT
    span_name,

    -- average exclusive CPU time per run (ms)
    AVG(self_cpu_ms) AS avg_self_cpu_ms,

    -- average “wait” time per run (ms) = wall − CPU, clamped at 0
    AVG(
        CASE
            WHEN self_wall_ms > self_cpu_ms
            THEN self_wall_ms - self_cpu_ms
            ELSE 0.0
        END
    ) AS avg_self_wait_ms,

    -- average exclusive wall time per run (ms), for ordering
    AVG(self_wall_ms) AS avg_self_wall_ms,

    COUNT(*) AS run_samples   -- how many runs contributed for this span
FROM span_per_run
GROUP BY
    span_name
ORDER BY
    avg_self_wall_ms DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    execution_duration_us / 1000.0 AS exec_ms,
    commit_duration_us    / 1000.0 AS commit_ms,
    (execution_duration_us + commit_duration_us) / 1000.0 AS total_ms
  FROM stacks_block_stats sbs
  WHERE 1 = 0 [[OR {{run_id}}]]
),

stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(total_ms) AS min_ms,
    MAX(total_ms) AS max_ms,
    COUNT(*)      AS n
  FROM filtered
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
),

params AS (
  SELECT
    min_ms,
    max_ms,
    (max_ms - min_ms) AS range_ms,

    -- width = ceil(range / max_buckets), but keep it >= 1ms
    CASE
      WHEN (max_ms - min_ms) <= 0 THEN 1.0
      WHEN (max_ms - min_ms) <= {{max_buckets}} THEN 1.0
      ELSE
        MAX(
          1.0,
          ((max_ms - min_ms) / CAST({{max_buckets}} AS FLOAT))
        )
    END AS bucket_width_ms
  FROM stats
),

grid AS (
  SELECT 0 AS bucket_idx
  UNION ALL
  SELECT bucket_idx + 1
  FROM grid, params
  WHERE (params.min_ms + (bucket_idx + 1) * params.bucket_width_ms) <= params.max_ms + 1e-9
),

bucketed AS (
  SELECT

WITH span_agg AS (
  SELECT
    s.context,
    s.name,
    s.context || ' ⭢ ' || s.name AS full_label,

    SUM(pr.call_count)   AS call_count,
    SUM(pr.sample_count) AS sample_count,

    -- Raw sampled totals (timed samples only)
    SUM(pr.self_wall_time_us) AS sampled_self_wall_us,
    SUM(pr.self_cpu_time_us)  AS sampled_self_cpu_us,

    -- Expanded totals (estimate for all observed calls)
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN pr.sample_count > 0
        THEN pr.self_wall_time_us * (pr.call_count * 1.0 / pr.sample_count)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS est_self_wall_us,

    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN pr.sample_count > 0
        THEN pr.self_cpu_time_us * (pr.call_count * 1.0 / pr.sample_count)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS est_self_cpu_us

  FROM profiler_record pr
  JOIN profiler_span s ON pr.profiler_span_id = s.id
  WHERE 1=0 [[OR {{run_id}}]]
  GROUP BY s.context, s.name
)

SELECT
  context,
  name,

  call_count,
  sample_count,
  (sample_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(call_count, 0)) AS sampling_rate,

  -- Estimated components for stacked CPU+WAIT
  (est_self_cpu_us / 1000.0) AS self_cpu_ms,
  (CASE
     WHEN est_self_wall_us > est_self_cpu_us
     THEN (est_self_wall_us - est_self_cpu_us) / 1000.0
     ELSE 0.0
   END) AS self_wait_ms,

  -- Total self wall (useful for ordering / labels)
  (est_self_wall_us / 1000.0) AS self_wall_ms,

  -- Averages per observed call (optional, but often useful in hover/details)
  ((est_self_cpu_us  * 1.0 / NULLIF(call_count, 0)) / 1000.0) AS avg_self_cpu_ms,
  ((CASE
      WHEN est_self_wall_us > est_self_cpu_us
      THEN (est_self_wall_us - est_self_cpu_us)
      ELSE 0
    END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(call_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS avg_self_wait_ms,

  -- Sampled-only averages (sanity checks)
  (sampled_self_wall_us * 1.0 / NULLIF(sample_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS avg_self_wall_ms_sampled,
  (sampled_self_cpu_us  * 1.0 / NULLIF(sample_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS avg_self_cpu_ms_sampled,

  CASE
    WHEN length(full_label) <= 40 THEN full_label
    ELSE '…' || substr(full_label, -39, 39)
  END AS span_label

FROM span_agg
-- Optional: stabilize rankings
-- WHERE sample_count >= 20
ORDER BY self_wall_ms DESC
LIMIT 15;

    c.name    AS contract,
    COALESCE(cf.name, '(unknown)') AS function,

    COUNT(*)                    AS call_count,
    SUM(sts.duration_us)/1000.0 AS total_ms,
    AVG(sts.duration_us)/1000.0 AS avg_ms
  FROM stacks_tx_stats sts
  JOIN stacks_tx tx
    ON tx.id = sts.stacks_tx_id
   AND tx.stacks_tx_type_id = 2  -- contract calls only

  -- if your stacks_block_id filter is based on real blocks (recommended)
  JOIN synthetic_block synth ON synth.id = sts.synthetic_block_id
  JOIN stacks_block sb        ON sb.id = synth.stacks_block_id

  JOIN contract c   ON c.id = tx.contract_id
  JOIN principal p  ON p.id = c.issuer_principal_id
  LEFT JOIN contract_fn cf ON cf.id = tx.contract_fn_id

  WHERE
    (1=0 [[OR {{run_id}}]])
    [[AND {{stacks_block_id}}]]
  GROUP BY issuer, contract, function
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_ms DESC) AS rn,

  fq_function AS "Fully-Qualified",
  issuer AS "Issuer",
  contract AS "Contract",
  function AS "Function",

  total_ms AS "Total Time (ms)",
  avg_ms AS "Avg. Time (ms)"

WITH 
-- 1. EXTRACT IDs
baseline_lookup AS (SELECT id FROM benchmark_run WHERE 1=0 [[OR {{baseline_run}}]]),
candidate_lookup AS (SELECT id FROM benchmark_run WHERE 1=0 [[OR {{candidate_run}}]]),

-- 2. ROOT SPAN LOOKUP
root_filter AS (
    SELECT id FROM profiler_span s WHERE 1=0 [[OR {{root_span_id}}]]
),

-- 3. IDENTIFY SHARED BLOCKS
shared_workload AS (
    SELECT s1.stacks_block_id
    FROM stacks_block_stats s1
    JOIN stacks_block_stats s2 ON s1.stacks_block_id = s2.stacks_block_id
    JOIN baseline_lookup b ON s1.benchmark_run_id = b.id
    JOIN candidate_lookup c ON s2.benchmark_run_id = c.id
),

-- 4. BUILD TREE A (Baseline)
tree_a_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.id, pr.parent_id, pr.profiler_span_id, pr.call_count,
        pr.wall_time_us, 
        pr.cpu_time_us -- NEW: Capture CPU
    FROM profiler_record pr
    JOIN baseline_lookup b ON pr.benchmark_run_id = b.id
    JOIN shared_workload sw ON pr.stacks_block_id = sw.stacks_block_id
),
tree_a_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        r.id, s.name as path_name, s.name as leaf_name, 0 as depth
    FROM tree_a_raw r
    JOIN profiler_span s ON r.profiler_span_id = s.id
    WHERE 
        (r.profiler_span_id IN (SELECT id FROM root_filter)) OR
        ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM root_filter) = 0 AND r.parent_id IS NULL)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        child.id, parent.path_name || '/' || s.name, s.name, parent.depth + 1
    FROM tree_a_raw child
    JOIN profiler_span s ON child.profiler_span_id = s.id
    JOIN tree_a_paths parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id
),
stats_a AS (
    SELECT 
        path_name, depth, leaf_name as display_name,
        SUM(tr.call_count) as total_calls,
        SUM(tr.wall_time_us) as total_wall,
        SUM(tr.cpu_time_us) as total_cpu -- NEW: Aggregate CPU
    FROM tree_a_paths tp
    JOIN tree_a_raw tr ON tp.id = tr.id
    GROUP BY path_name, depth, leaf_name
),

-- 5. BUILD TREE B (Candidate)
tree_b_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.id, pr.parent_id, pr.profiler_span_id, pr.call_count,
        pr.wall_time_us, 
        pr.cpu_time_us -- NEW
    FROM profiler_record pr
    JOIN candidate_lookup c ON pr.benchmark_run_id = c.id
    JOIN shared_workload sw ON pr.stacks_block_id = sw.stacks_block_id
),
tree_b_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        r.id, s.name as path_name, s.name as leaf_name, 0 as depth
    FROM tree_b_raw r
    JOIN profiler_span s ON r.profiler_span_id = s.id
    WHERE 
        (r.profiler_span_id IN (SELECT id FROM root_filter)) OR
        ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM root_filter) = 0 AND r.parent_id IS NULL)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        child.id, parent.path_name || '/' || s.name, s.name, parent.depth + 1
    FROM tree_b_raw child
    JOIN profiler_span s ON child.profiler_span_id = s.id
    JOIN tree_b_paths parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id
),
stats_b AS (
    SELECT 
        path_name, depth, leaf_name as display_name,
        SUM(tr.call_count) as total_calls,
        SUM(tr.wall_time_us) as total_wall,
        SUM(tr.cpu_time_us) as total_cpu -- NEW
    FROM tree_b_paths tp
    JOIN tree_b_raw tr ON tp.id = tr.id
    GROUP BY path_name, depth, leaf_name
)

-- 6. FINAL DIFF
SELECT 
    -- Indentation
    substr('⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ⠂   ', 1, COALESCE(a.depth, b.depth) * 4) 
    || '↳ ' || COALESCE(a.display_name, b.display_name) AS "Call Tree",

    (COALESCE(b.total_calls, 0) - COALESCE(a.total_calls, 0)) AS "Count Diff",

    -- 1. Wall Diff
    (COALESCE(b.total_wall, 0) - COALESCE(a.total_wall, 0)) / 1000.0 AS "Total Wall Diff (ms)",

    -- 2. CPU Diff
    (COALESCE(b.total_cpu, 0) - COALESCE(a.total_cpu, 0)) / 1000.0 AS "Total CPU Diff (ms)",

    -- 3. Wait Diff (Wall - CPU)
    (
      (COALESCE(b.total_wall, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_cpu, 0)) - 
      (COALESCE(a.total_wall, 0) - COALESCE(a.total_cpu, 0))
    ) / 1000.0 AS "Total Wait Diff (ms)",

    COALESCE(a.depth, b.depth) as depth_sort

FROM stats_a a
FULL OUTER JOIN stats_b b ON a.path_name = b.path_name
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.path_name, b.path_name) ASC
LIMIT 2000

WITH 
-- 1. EXTRACT BASELINE ID
-- We apply the field filter here exactly once against 'benchmark_run'.
baseline_lookup AS (
    SELECT id 
    FROM benchmark_run 
    WHERE 1=0 [[OR {{baseline_run}}]]
),

-- 2. EXTRACT CANDIDATE ID
-- We apply the second field filter here exactly once.
candidate_lookup AS (
    SELECT id 
    FROM benchmark_run 
    WHERE 1=0 [[OR {{candidate_run}}]]
),

-- 3. CALCULATE SHARED BLOCKS
-- Now we use the IDs from the CTEs above, avoiding the Field Filter syntax entirely.
shared_workload AS (
    SELECT s1.stacks_block_id
    FROM stacks_block_stats s1
    JOIN stacks_block_stats s2 ON s1.stacks_block_id = s2.stacks_block_id
    -- Join against our lookup CTEs
    JOIN baseline_lookup b_id ON s1.benchmark_run_id = b_id.id
    JOIN candidate_lookup c_id ON s2.benchmark_run_id = c_id.id
),

-- 4. AGGREGATE BASELINE (Run A)
stats_a AS (
    SELECT 
        s.name, 
        SUM(pr.self_wall_time_us) as wall,
        SUM(pr.self_cpu_time_us)  as cpu,
        SUM(pr.call_count)        as calls
    FROM profiler_record pr 
    JOIN profiler_span s ON pr.profiler_span_id = s.id
    -- Join against the Baseline ID CTE
    JOIN baseline_lookup b_id ON pr.benchmark_run_id = b_id.id
    -- Join against the Intersection CTE
    JOIN shared_workload sw ON pr.stacks_block_id = sw.stacks_block_id
    GROUP BY s.name
),

-- 5. AGGREGATE CANDIDATE (Run B)
stats_b AS (
    SELECT 
        s.name, 
        SUM(pr.self_wall_time_us) as wall,
        SUM(pr.self_cpu_time_us)  as cpu,
        SUM(pr.call_count)        as calls
    FROM profiler_record pr 
    JOIN profiler_span s ON pr.profiler_span_id = s.id
    -- Join against the Candidate ID CTE
    JOIN candidate_lookup c_id ON pr.benchmark_run_id = c_id.id
    -- Join against the Intersection CTE
    JOIN shared_workload sw ON pr.stacks_block_id = sw.stacks_block_id
    GROUP BY s.name
)

-- 6. FINAL DIFF CALCULATION
SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.name, b.name) as "Span Name",
    
    -- Context
    (COALESCE(b.calls, 0) - COALESCE(a.calls, 0)) as "Count Diff",

    -- Wall Diff
    (
      (COALESCE(b.wall, 0.0) / NULLIF(b.calls, 0)) - 
      (COALESCE(a.wall, 0.0) / NULLIF(a.calls, 0))
    ) as "Avg Wall Diff (us)",

    -- CPU Diff
    (
      (COALESCE(b.cpu, 0.0) / NULLIF(b.calls, 0)) - 
      (COALESCE(a.cpu, 0.0) / NULLIF(a.calls, 0))
    ) as "Avg CPU Diff (us)",

    -- Wait Diff
    (
      ((COALESCE(b.wall, 0.0) - COALESCE(b.cpu, 0.0)) / NULLIF(b.calls, 0)) - 
      ((COALESCE(a.wall, 0.0) - COALESCE(a.cpu, 0.0)) / NULLIF(a.calls, 0))
    ) as "Avg Wait Diff (us)"

FROM stats_a a
FULL OUTER JOIN stats_b b ON a.name = b.name

-- Filter noise: Only show items where Wall avg changed by > 1us
WHERE ABS(
    (COALESCE(b.wall, 0.0) / NULLIF(b.calls, 0)) - 
    (COALESCE(a.wall, 0.0) / NULLIF(a.calls, 0))
) > 1.0

ORDER BY ABS("Avg Wall Diff (us)") DESC
LIMIT 50

    pr.call_count,
    pr.sample_count,
    CAST(ROUND(pr.wall_time_us * 1.0 / NULLIF(pr.sample_count, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS us
  FROM profiler_record pr
  WHERE
    (1=0 [[OR {{run_id}}]])
    AND (1=0 [[OR {{span_id}}]])
    [[AND {{stacks_block_id}}]]
    [[AND {{stacks_tx_id}}]]
    AND pr.sample_count > 0
),
p99 AS (
  SELECT us AS p99_us
  FROM scoped
  ORDER BY us
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET (
    SELECT CAST(0.99 * (COUNT(*) - 1) AS INTEGER) FROM scoped
  )
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM scoped s, p99
  WHERE s.us <= p99.p99_us
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(us) AS min_us,
    MAX(us) AS max_us,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM filtered
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
),
params AS (
  SELECT
    min_us,
    max_us,
    (max_us - min_us + 1) AS range_us,

    -- bucket_width_us = ceil(range_us / max_buckets), at least 1
    CASE
      WHEN (max_us - min_us + 1) <= {{max_buckets}} THEN 1
      ELSE CAST(((max_us - min_us + 1) + {{max_buckets}} - 1) / {{max_buckets}} AS INTEGER)
    END AS bucket_width_us
  FROM stats
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((f.us - p.min_us) / p.bucket_width_us AS INTEGER) AS bucket_idx,

    -- numeric X: bucket center
    (p.min_us
      + CAST((f.us - p.min_us) / p.bucket_width_us AS INTEGER) * p.bucket_width_us
      + (p.bucket_width_us / 2.0)
    ) AS us,

    SUM(f.call_count)   AS "Call Count",
    SUM(f.sample_count) AS "Sample Count",

    -- optional, hide but useful
    (p.min_us + CAST((f.us - p.min_us) / p.bucket_width_us AS INTEGER) * p.bucket_width_us) AS "Bucket Start (µs)",
    (p.min_us + (CAST((f.us - p.min_us) / p.bucket_width_us AS INTEGER) + 1) * p.bucket_width_us - 1) AS "Bucket End (µs)",
    p.bucket_width_us AS "Bucket Width (µs)"
  FROM filtered f
  CROSS JOIN params p
  GROUP BY bucket_idx
)
SELECT
  us,
  "Call Count",
  "Sample Count",
  "Bucket Start (µs)",
  "Bucket End (µs)",
  "Bucket Width (µs)",
  bucket_idx
FROM bucketed
ORDER BY bucket_idx;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT
    pr.call_count,
    pr.sample_count,
    pr.wall_time_us,
    pr.self_wall_time_us,
    pr.cpu_time_us,
    pr.self_cpu_time_us
  FROM profiler_record pr
  WHERE
    (1=0 [[OR {{run_id}}]])
    AND (1=0 [[OR {{span_id}}]])
    [[AND {{stacks_block_id}}]]
    [[AND {{stacks_tx_id}}]]
),

agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(call_count)   AS total_calls,
    SUM(sample_count) AS total_samples,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sample_count = 0 THEN call_count ELSE 0 END) AS missing_calls,

    -- estimated totals (expanded for sampling)
    SUM(CASE WHEN sample_count > 0 THEN wall_time_us      * (call_count * 1.0 / sample_count) ELSE 0 END) AS est_wall_us,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sample_count > 0 THEN self_wall_time_us * (call_count * 1.0 / sample_count) ELSE 0 END) AS est_self_wall_us,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sample_count > 0 THEN cpu_time_us       * (call_count * 1.0 / sample_count) ELSE 0 END) AS est_cpu_us,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sample_count > 0 THEN self_cpu_time_us  * (call_count * 1.0 / sample_count) ELSE 0 END) AS est_self_cpu_us
  FROM scoped
),

per_record AS (
  -- One row per profiler_record “context”, with a per-call mean (ms) computed from timed samples.
  -- This is what we can percentile over.
  SELECT
    (wall_time_us      * 1.0 / NULLIF(sample_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS wall_ms_per_call,
    (cpu_time_us       * 1.0 / NULLIF(sample_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS busy_ms_per_call,
    (max(0, wall_time_us - cpu_time_us) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sample_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS wait_ms_per_call,

    (max(0, self_wall_time_us) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sample_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS self_wall_ms_per_call,
    (max(0, self_cpu_time_us)  * 1.0 / NULLIF(sample_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS self_busy_ms_per_call,
    (max(0, max(0, self_wall_time_us) - max(0, self_cpu_time_us)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sample_count, 0)) / 1000.0 AS self_wait_ms_per_call
  FROM scoped
  WHERE sample_count > 0
),

mins_maxes AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(wall_ms_per_call) AS wall_min,
    MAX(wall_ms_per_call) AS wall_max,
    MIN(busy_ms_per_call) AS busy_min,
    MAX(busy_ms_per_call) AS busy_max,
    MIN(self_wall_ms_per_call) AS self_wall_min,
    MAX(self_wall_ms_per_call) AS self_wall_max,
    MIN(self_busy_ms_per_call) AS self_busy_min,
    MAX(self_busy_ms_per_call) AS self_busy_max
  FROM per_record
),

-- Percentile helper: pick value at floor(p*(n-1)) in sorted order
pcts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT wall_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY wall_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.90*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS wall_p90,
    (SELECT wall_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY wall_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.95*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS wall_p95,
    (SELECT wall_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY wall_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.98*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS wall_p98,

    (SELECT busy_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY busy_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.90*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS busy_p90,
    (SELECT busy_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY busy_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.95*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS busy_p95,
    (SELECT busy_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY busy_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.98*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS busy_p98,

    (SELECT self_wall_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY self_wall_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.90*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS self_wall_p90,
    (SELECT self_wall_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY self_wall_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.95*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS self_wall_p95,
    (SELECT self_wall_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY self_wall_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.98*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS self_wall_p98,

    (SELECT self_busy_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY self_busy_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.90*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS self_busy_p90,
    (SELECT self_busy_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY self_busy_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.95*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS self_busy_p95,
    (SELECT self_busy_ms_per_call FROM per_record ORDER BY self_busy_ms_per_call LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(0.98*(COUNT(*)-1) AS INTEGER) FROM per_record)) AS self_busy_p98
)

SELECT
  a.total_calls,
  a.total_samples,
  (a.total_samples * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.total_calls, 0)) AS sampling_rate,
  a.missing_calls,

  -- Overall means (ms per observed call), sampling-expanded
  (a.est_wall_us * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.total_calls, 0)) / 1000.0 AS avg_wall_ms,
  (a.est_cpu_us  * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.total_calls, 0)) / 1000.0 AS avg_busy_ms,
  (max(0, a.est_wall_us - a.est_cpu_us) * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.total_calls, 0)) / 1000.0 AS avg_wait_ms,

  (max(0, a.est_self_wall_us) * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.total_calls, 0)) / 1000.0 AS avg_self_wall_ms,
  (max(0, a.est_self_cpu_us)  * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.total_calls, 0)) / 1000.0 AS avg_self_busy_ms,

  
  -- actual min/max over per-record per-call means
  mm.wall_min, mm.wall_max,
  mm.busy_min, mm.busy_max,
  mm.self_wall_min, mm.self_wall_max,
  mm.self_busy_min, mm.self_busy_max,

  -- “Trimmed min/max” via percentiles over per-record per-call means
  p.wall_p90, p.wall_p95, p.wall_p98,
  p.busy_p90, p.busy_p95, p.busy_p98,
  p.self_wall_p90, p.self_wall_p95, p.self_wall_p98,
  p.self_busy_p90, p.self_busy_p95, p.self_busy_p98

FROM agg a
CROSS JOIN mins_maxes mm
CROSS JOIN pcts p;

WITH bp AS (
  SELECT
    benchmark_run_id,
    warmup_blocks,
    measured_blocks,
    avg_setup_us,
    avg_finalize_us,
    avg_clarity_commit_us,

  SELECT 'Setup'          AS stage, avg_setup_us          AS us FROM bp
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Finalize'       , avg_finalize_us       FROM bp
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Clarity Commit' , avg_clarity_commit_us FROM bp
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Advance Tip'    , avg_advance_tip_us    FROM bp

  (us / 1000.0) AS "Time (ms)",

  bp.warmup_blocks   AS "Warmup Blocks",
  bp.measured_blocks AS "Measured Blocks"
FROM slices
CROSS JOIN tot t

WITH 
scoped AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.benchmark_run_id,
    pr.parent_id,
    pr.wall_time_us,
    pr.cpu_time_us,
    pr.self_wall_time_us,
    pr.self_cpu_time_us,
    span.context AS span_context,
    span.name AS span_name
  FROM profiler_record pr
  JOIN profiler_span span ON span.id = pr.profiler_span_id
  WHERE 1=0 [[OR {{run_id}}]]
),
segment_root AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(wall_time_us) AS total_wall_us,
    SUM(cpu_time_us) AS total_busy_us,
    SUM(wall_time_us) - SUM(cpu_time_us) AS total_wait_us
  FROM scoped
  WHERE span_name = 'Segment' AND parent_id IS NULL
),
agg_data AS (
  SELECT
    s.span_name,
    SUM(s.wall_time_us) AS wall_us,
    SUM(s.cpu_time_us) AS busy_us,
    SUM(s.self_wall_time_us) AS self_wall_us,
    SUM(s.self_cpu_time_us) AS self_busy_us
  FROM scoped s
  WHERE s.span_name LIKE 'Segment%' AND s.span_name <> 'Segment'
  GROUP BY s.span_name
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    (a.wall_us - a.busy_us) AS wait_us,
    MAX(0, a.self_wall_us - a.self_busy_us) AS self_wait_us,
    CASE WHEN r.total_wall_us > 0 THEN 100.0 * a.wall_us / r.total_wall_us END AS wall_pct,
    CASE WHEN r.total_busy_us > 0 THEN 100.0 * a.busy_us / r.total_busy_us END AS busy_pct,
    CASE WHEN r.total_wait_us > 0 THEN 100.0 * (a.wall_us - a.busy_us) / r.total_wait_us END AS wait_pct
  FROM agg_data a
  CROSS JOIN segment_root r
)
SELECT 
  span_name AS "Profiler Span",
  wall_us / 1000.0 AS "Total Wall Time (ms)",
  busy_us / 1000.0 AS "Busy (ms)",
  wait_us / 1000.0 AS "Wait (ms)",
  MAX(0.0, self_wall_us / 1000.0) AS "Self: Total Wall Time (ms)",
  self_busy_us / 1000.0 AS "Self: Busy (ms)",
  self_wait_us / 1000.0 AS "Self: Wait (ms)",
  wall_pct AS "Total Wall Time (%)",
  busy_pct AS "Busy (%)",
  wait_pct AS "Wait (%)"
FROM stats;
